HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Vex 3 is the third platform game in the Vex series, offering players an exciting and challenging experience with unexpected turns and hazardous obstacles.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use [W], [A], [S], [D], or the arrow keys to move.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Jump from side to side to climb up walls.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Press the down arrow key while standing on a new act's act block to play the new one.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Navigate through a maze of spinning blades, spikes, and traps.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Purple blocks are weak and will fall when stepped on, while orange blocks are bouncy and great for high jumps.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Complete each act by avoiding lethal traps and equipment to progress.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Experience unexpected turns and thrilling levels that keep you engaged.
